paragraphs: Chapter 1053
Episode 251. The Great Adversaries(3)
For a while, Orgal and his colleagues stared intently at Jin. Only Sandra seemed satisfied.
[Well, alright. We need to have a meeting.]
Orgal was the first to break the mood, opening his mouth with a face indicating his enthusiasm had died down.
[But what are we going to discuss in the meeting? Other than Kinzelo's decision to treat you as allies from now on, is there really anything else to talk about?]
"Orgal, today's meeting started because you suddenly showed up, and you're saying that?"
[Counter that if you can.]
At this, Jin was momentarily at a loss for words.
Because it was true.
Orgal had informed the Vamel Alliance about the truth of the world, the existence of the multiverse, and the immense power held by Zipple.
However, for now, knowing the truth meant there were only a limited number of responses they could prepare.

'The Zipple of another dimension,' the Demon Lords, in some ways, were quite an abstract enemy. They knew of its existence and that it was somehow helping the Zipple of this world through certain means, but that was all.
Where they were, how they operated, how they moved between worlds—those gathered here had no idea.

"…As you say, let's first clarify the situation about the alliance. The Vamel Alliance will also cease all attacks on Kinzelo for now. However, if we perceive any change in your stance towards Zipple, this agreement can be withdrawn at any time."

[Do as you like. But I advise you to lower your unnecessary guard. Even without the Zipple of another dimension, the Demon Lords, there are already many problems in the world. Jin, you didn't even know that Bligiet had gone to the Tower of Story until I told you.]
That was true. The Tower of Story was currently changing locations and was difficult to track even with record magic.

[We will continue to share all the information we come across with you. If it helps in dealing with Zipple, anything. Anyway, we can't let Bligiet get what he wants from Zipple. Let's hope the Abyss Legion can stop it.]

"I was curious about that part. Orgal, I heard that the Abyss Legion is directly attacking the Tower of Story through your steel dimension gate. Wouldn't it be better if the alliance's strongest forces could invade it all at once?"

[That's impossible. First, the reason why the Abyss Legion can directly attack the Tower of Story is that they fundamentally do not belong to this dimension. It's completely impossible for you or me to enter the Tower of Story directly through the steel gate. The Tower rejects it. It's not a realm that can be resolved by the power of beings like Battle Goddess Vahn.]
Orgal explained that the Tower couldn't block the Abyss Legion because it hadn't yet identified their 'true nature'.

[As the Origin Stone evolves and the Tower recognizes the identity of the Abyss Legion, they too will become unable to avoid manipulation. In other words, the Abyss Legion won't have much time to come and go in the Tower of Story like this.]

Orgal opened a dimension gate to gain Jin's trust. And as soon as they saw that gate, Vahn, Jin, and Luna immediately shook their heads. The insight of Genesis told them so. This was a gate they couldn't enter.
[You can check later with record magic that this isn't my trick. Genesis won't need to. Or, go out and bring Valeria now if you want.]
"I understand. You know about the downfall of the Sun God Religion, right?"
[I know. Battle Goddess Vahn... If she had been whole and fought alongside me in any of those numerous battles I've fought, the outcome might have been different. Damn it.]

"So, the remaining enemies of the alliance, apart from your Kinzelo, are Ganesto, and the selves of the Sun God who want the destruction or reconstruction of the world, and Zipple. What do you think about Ganesto?"
[Before I knew the truth, it was a place led by a bug that broke my great endeavor. Lokia Ganesto... Helluram said, they are like the dregs of dimensional difference.]
"The dregs of dimensional difference?"
[When Zipple first manipulated history, causing the world to differentiate, a kind of impurity was continually produced. That gathered together to become the current Ganesto family.]
"How was Lokia in your memories of other worlds?"
[Similar to now. Scheming behind the scenes, pulling strings, gaining Helluram's attention and then leaving her...]

"In my opinion, Lokia and the group are trying to create their own paradise. And once the paradise is complete, they'll either leave for that place, destroy this world and leave, or replace this world entirely with their paradise."

[The third option is likely the correct one. When you meet them, tell them to wake up from their dream. With the Demon Lords watching over this place, what can those insignificant beings really do? However, there's a high chance that they will side with Zipple.]
"Why is that?"

[The Kelliark of this world, compared to the Kelliarks I've encountered in other worlds, isn't that impressive. He hasn't even reached Genesis on his own, and he even fell to the depths of hell, pushed down by the crazy Veradin. No one here would think he's stronger than other Genesis.]
That was a fair point. Without the terrifying and formidable object known as the ‘Origin Stone', the Genesis of the Alliance would be confident enough to tear Kelliark apart immediately.

[That's why, from Lokia's perspective, Kelliark would be an attractive target, right? Pretending to be subordinate and then stabbing Kelliark in the back could bring the Origin Stone into her hands. Of course, the Demon Lords won't just sit by and let that happen, so whatever Lokia does, she's bound to fail.]
"You sound confident. You don't think Ganesto will pose much of a threat."

[I can't be entirely sure. There are variables like you and Valeria, so who can say it won't happen again? Surprisingly, the Demon Lords might even make a deal with Lokia. If I were them, I would rather have this world's Kelliark end at the hands of someone like Lokia and then make him the leader of Zipple. Anyway, the Ganestos are like cockroaches that need to be crushed.]
Jin nodded quietly. Generally, Orgal was making points he could agree with.
[Now that we're talking, there seems to be a lot to discuss. Jin Runcandel, what do you think is the most important thing right now?]

"Tracking and attacking the Tower of Story. The Abyss Legion is probably stronger than any force that has existed in the Human World, but they can't deliver the final blow. As you said, once the Origin Stone recognizes its true nature, they won't be able to infiltrate like they do now."

[That's correct. Most of the soldiers in the Abyss Legion are Orgals from other worlds, but there are also Lunas and even Sirons. However, essentially, they are just worn-out bio-weapons, incapable of fighting like the originals, like true Genesis.”
Ultimately, it's up to real people to attack the Tower of Story and wield the Origin Stone. The Abyss Legion alone could never bring an end to the war.
"Is there a way to find the location of the Tower?"
[Heluram has offered to help. However, as she doesn't have much capacity left, much of it will fall to Valeria Hister, who just made a public confession earlier.]
"Drop the public confession talk, Orgal. It's been bothering me since earlier. Just know that I'm letting this slide because I'm uncomfortable swearing at you due to memories from other worlds."
"Heluram... It's true that we've come to know incredible truths thanks to the witch, but honestly, I can't trust her. Her intentions are unclear."
[Didn't I tell you that Heluram's goal is to eradicate light from the world?]
"A world ending at the hands of Zipple could also be seen as a world without light. Eradicating light is a statement that can be interpreted in many ways."

[Smart Jin Runcandel saying something foolish for the first time in a while. If she wanted that, she wouldn't have told me the truth! Anyway, if you doubt Helluram's intentions, wait for the subspace of Solderet, which Chiron is searching for, to be revealed. If Solderet knew the truth of this world, then there might be information about Helluram there too.]
Orgal looked at the Abyss Legion beside him and suddenly opened a dimensional gate.

[Yes, that's a good idea. Hey, friends. Go to the Black Sea now. Help out Chiron. Once you enter the deep parts of the Black Sea, find the place where you feel Solderet's energy. Ah wait, take this note. It says you're good friends sent by Orgal and Jin Runcandel... Jin, just sign here for me.]
After Jin shrugged and signed, the Abyss Legion silently entered the dimensional gate, leading to the vicinity of the Black Sea.
For Luna, Luntia, Veradin, Hedo, and Sandra, it was a bit unsettling.

[Don't think of it as too uncomfortable, they're just poor beings, mere remnants of you and me. You know? The soldiers of the Abyss Legion suffer the most when they're idle. They start remembering their defeats in past worlds. That's something they will never forget.]
"I'm not sure if the Abyss Legion can find Chiron. I met him easily thanks to the foolish actions of the Sun God Religion and Nirgand."
[If they can't find him, they'll return on their own, Vahn. The friends who just left are warriors specialized for the Black Sea. No chaos can taint them, not even Helluram's soul energy…]

From Orgal's perspective, the continuously growing Abyss Legion helping Chiron wouldn't be a bad thing at all. He was as eager to confirm Solderet's arrangements as Chiron was. That would help determine whether Solderet was innocent or not.
[Well, it seems we've roughly sorted things out. For now, we'll focus on tracking the Tower of Story, while keeping an eye on the movements of Ganesto and the
selves of the Sun God. Valeria will have the most work to do. Leader, please deliver this directly and respond to the confession.]
